Author: Alex Vallière
Name: Submarine ETA Planner
Punchline: Estimate submarine ETAs to your chosen rank.
Description: Forecast submarine ETAs to a chosen rank using SubmarineTracker voyage, build, EXP, and FC-wide probabilistic unlock data. Requires Submarine Tracker to be installed and enabled. Open it with /seta. The installer icon was created with AI assistance.
Changelog: Corrects farming fuel configuration with an explicit stock-source mode and a version 12-to-13 migration.
